hideMarkers._note: day 35: this page does not draw the score's markers. The trance section's beat numbers and structural labels are rehearsal scaffolding, not notation.

animated._note: day 35 in the code, day 36 in this schema: a page may switch OFF animated object kinds it does not want (animobj.collect's kindOn filter) - the morph pages want their two meters and none of the dots, the trance page wants its ball and no progress rings over the long tones. FIFTH TIME THE GATE HAS BITTEN (see _kindNote..3 and devices[].preset): all three morph pages have carried `animated` since day 35 and NONE of them ever passed validation, because notate_morph.js writes without validating (NITS). The property was legal in the renderer and illegal in the file, and the first VALIDATED page to carry one was REJECTED and DELETED on write.

build.description: amendment 6 (2026-08-23): the exact command line that produced this document. A version file is derived — the archive plus the composer's decisions — and those decisions ARE the argv; storing it lets the file say how to rebuild itself without the journal.

env.description: envelope species as drawn (surge, sine, expodec, ...) — day 22 amendment 3, optional; 'strike' = a note the strikes tool wrote (§400); 'trill' = a composer-score trill zone (PLAN 2f.3, 2026-09-13); a crescendo-tool swell carries its family name (properties.cresc.shape: 'surge' = the standard — PLAN 2i.8, 2026-09-15)

secco.description: the swell ends secco — the strings damp at the cut, the winds take the word for the shape (the crescendo tool's properties.cresc.secco, CN-49); the page writes 'sempre secco' once per part at its first such event (D54) — PLAN 2i.8 amendment 9, 2026-09-15, optional

mode.description: non-default sonify mode (plain = captured note, ks = keyswitched sample); curve mode = field omitted — day 22 amendment 3, optional

vel.description: the captured MIDI velocity of a plain-mode note (the score object's recVel — a play-in or engine value, see DYNAMICS_FRAMEWORK.md §2); the one-shot dynamic mark derives from it through registry dynamicBands — day 23 amendment 5, optional, plain-mode events only

level.description: the drawn level curve, normalized samples 0-1 over the note span (piece #1 curve-library precedent; sampled at extract time by sonify_core.evalWaveCurve) — day 22 amendment 4, optional, curve-mode events only; for env trill: the composer score's own trill reference (auto/A/B/C/lane/flat) sampled over the trill span with composer.html getYAtPos (PLAN 2f.3)

trill.description: PLAN 2f.3 (2026-09-13) — an env trill event's neighbour and curve reference (docs/TRILL_NOTATION_SPEC.md §1). The sounding neighbour = pitch.midi + interval; spelled = the next letter name up (a second). curve names the reference the level was sampled from (auto:A, C, lane, flat ...).

preset._note: day 36, THE PER-PART BALL: a chunk gc device may carry a GC preset — the trance revision tiles one ball per lane at each part's own tempo (preset.duration = that part's step, so the balls abut with no gap and no overlap). Without this property the node's additionalProperties:false REJECTED the page and ir_validate DELETED it on write — the fourth time the gate has bitten (see _kindNote..3).

properties._kindNote: day 23 amendment 6: 'engraving' — the V1 per-item override channel (value.device = a device-membership override; also stemDir, spelled, nudges). layout.js has consumed it since day 22, but the enum never listed it, so a VALIDATED IR could not carry one — the channel existed only in hand-built test objects. Found the moment the first real one was written (the composer's beamed cluster, notate_section --cluster).

overlay._kindNote2: day 35: 'gliss', 'cresc' and 'header' - the morph-section channels. A gliss/cresc overlay carries {part, span} and a normalised 0..1 sample array: the drawn displacement curve for that part's half of the lane. A header overlay carries {part, t} and the section's written pitches plus its dynamic figure. Added the moment the first real one was folded into a VALIDATED page - exactly the failure the note above records for 'engraving', and it bit the same way: notate_morph.js writes its own files unvalidated, so three morph pages existed and passed nothing, while the first attempt to fold them into MAIN DRAFT was REJECTED and the page DELETED. The standalone writer should validate too; see NITS.
overlay._kindNote3: day 35: 'tempo' - the trance section's bar lines. A tempo overlay carries {t} and {bpm}: a bar line on every part at that moment, a medium space left of the bar's leftmost ink, with the tempo stated once at the top. Third time the enum has had to be widened for a channel layout.js already understood (see _kindNote and _kindNote2). The pattern is now clear enough to name: THIS SCHEMA IS A GATE ON THE FILE, NOT A DESCRIPTION OF THE RENDERER, so any new overlay kind must be added here in the same commit or the page is rejected and DELETED on write.
